modifier.galtc2.rude.flavor: Deal extra damage to enemies with more than 20 health
modifier.galtc2.eightstrike.flavor: High attack speed, ignores invincibility frames
modifier.galtc2.kagome.flavor: Kagome bears the negative effects for you
modifier.galtc2.narcissus.flavor: Deals additional damage equal to 15% of target's maximum health
modifier.galtc2.valuation.flavor: Based on luck value, small chance to damage yourself, high chance to deal 1~99x damage to enemies
modifier.galtc2.steinsgate.flavor: Deceive the world, fake death once
modifier.galtc2.steinsgate.description: After feigning death, restores health and grants 2s invincibility, 60s cooldown
modifier.galtc2.azarashi.description: When attack value exceeds 100, triple the damage
modifier.galtc2.nighttimesheep.descripti: Attack values below 50 receive additional bonus
modifier.galtc2.oumunnbyou.flavor: Has a chance to stack cherry blossom marks
modifier.galtc2.oumunnbyou.description: After 5 cherry blossom marks, deals massive damage
modifier.galtc2.kisaragikurenai.descript: Deals extra damage to non-spider creatures, increases health (armor)
modifier.galtc2.tagetes.description: Increases attack power based on lost health
modifier.galtc2.lavare.description: Deals extra damage to high health and high armor targets
modifier.galtc2.muramasa.description: After killing an enemy creature, must kill a friendly creature
modifier.galtc2.aid.flavor: High-performance robots resist damage for you
modifier.galtc2.aid.description: After taking damage, resist the same type of damage for 30s
modifier.galtc2.aia.description: After taking 50 hits, increase armor and armor toughness by 1 point
modifier.galtc2.shochou.description: Has a chance to drop money on hit, 2s cooldown
modifier.galtc2.shochou.description.dyna: Has a chance to drop money on hit, 2s cooldown
modifier.galtc2.healed_by_sister.descrip: Increases health regeneration, recovery amount scales with modifier level
modifier.galtc2.kisaki.flavor: I won't allow my brother to be happy alone
modifier.galtc2.kisaki.description: While worn as armor: +4% damage reduction per game day worn (max 80%). Cost: Curse of Binding, fire damage taken x2 ignoring reduction, fire cannot be extinguished. Dying to fire resets reduction and forcibly unequips armor.
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_likes.flavor: I want to be a little sister who is proud of loving her elder brother deeply
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_likes.description: When used as a weapon: attacking creatures that recently damaged you returns 30%/level of the damage they dealt. With an empty offhand or another Kisaki-made item, the main hand weapon repairs 0.5% durability per second and you regenerate 1 HP per second.
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_hates.flavor: If I were to fall in love with another man, I would rather die holding my longing for Ruri
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_hates.description: When used as a weapon: if the offhand holds a weapon not made of Kisaki material, it loses 1% durability per second.
modifier.galtc2.meatbun.description: When equipped, hunger does not decrease
modifier.galtc2.vtb.flavor: Extra damage based on max health
modifier.galtc2.vtb.description: Adds 50% of max health as extra damage on attack
modifier.galtc2.qien.description: Adds damage based on current time, uses the larger of minute and hour
modifier.galtc2.yidian.description: Grants extra armor and armor toughness, larger value is armor, smaller is toughness
modifier.galtc2.rewrite.description: Steals target's armor and health on hit, lasts until death or 60s
modifier.galtc2.heartwall.description: Provides extra shield that absorbs damage first, regenerates 1 per second
modifier.galtc2.zoulezoule.description: Each level increases attack speed by 10%
modifier.galtc2.camus.description: Applies healing prevention when attacking or being attacked in non-rainy daytime
modifier.galtc2.wonderful.description: Double damage when falling from over 72 blocks
modifier.galtc2.starry_travel.descriptio: More damage the farther from spawn, +1 per 5 chunks
modifier.galtc2.starry_travel_armor.desc: More armor the farther from spawn, +1 per 5 chunks
modifier.galtc2.super_lucky.description: +10 Fortune for pickaxe, +10 Looting for weapons
modifier.galtc2.super_lucky.requirements: Super High School Level Lucky requires Luck III as a prerequisite
material.galtc2.narcissus.encyclopedia: If your life had a countdown, what would you think about?
material.galtc2.muramasa.encyclopedia: This is Not a Hero's Tale
material.galtc2.tsukiyashiro_kisaki.ency: Armor that grows stronger the longer it is worn, but fire is its price
material.galtc2.nishiki_asumi.encycloped: Never hungry, extra damage based on max health
material.galtc2.rewrite.encyclopedia: Steals target's armor and health on hit
message.galtc.death_immunity: Deceive the world, El Psy Congroo
modifier.galtc2.scroll_cast.flavor: Imprint a flawless magic scroll into your tool.
modifier.galtc2.scroll_cast.description: Hold the tool, put a spell-bearing Flawless Magic Scroll in your offhand and sneak to copy the spell into the tool (consumes the scroll). Melee spells trigger on hit; other spells cast on right-click.
modifier.galtc2.fire_apostle.description: Each armor piece reduces fire damage taken by 20% and increases fire damage dealt by 30%.
material.galtc2.saya.encyclopedia: A dark-green indescribable thing, said to come from Saya.
modifier.galtc2.saya.description: After a melee hit, summons a tentacle near the target to help attack (tentacle from J Village; requires J Village).
material.galtc2.shoujing.encyclopedia: The power of Shoujing, balanced between offense and defense.
modifier.galtc2.shoujing.description: Calls the Darisorder to fight for you when you attack or are hit (from J Village; requires J Village).
material.galtc2.euthanasia.encyclopedia: Melee and ranged attacks alike bring down an unclean rain of blood.
modifier.galtc2.euthanasia.description: Melee and arrow hits call down an unclean rain of blood on the target (spell from J Village; requires J Village).
